name: Checkiday API
tagline: National and fun day-of holidays beyond statutory calendars
description: API for current and historical national, fun, and observance "day of" holidays (e.g. National Pizza Day). Use for calendars, apps, and content that need today’s observances beyond statutory holidays.

auth.details: API key authentication; confirm header and signup flow from current docs

use_cases: list today’s national and fun holidays
look up observances for a given date
